# Captured fan-in suite log excerpt (2026-09-20) — a real failure, kept as a fixture so the probe's
# self-test does not depend on which .quay/fan-in-suite-*.log happens to be the newest one; the
# driver prunes those.
#
# Two line shapes matter here:
#   __PERFILE__ … <file>|<pseudo-file> passed=<true|false> …  per-file records emitted by scripts/test.sh
#   not ok - …                                                failing-file records
# `lint` and `typecheck` are PATHLESS pseudo-files. A `not ok - lint:` line names a real file after
# the colon — that is a file the parser must attribute — while the pseudo-file itself is not a test.

__PERFILE_KIND__ file=lint kind=assert
